name: Analog Devices
outlook:
What Analog Devices says to expect

  • Fourth quarter fiscal 2026: revenue, margins and EPSFor the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, we are forecasting revenue of $4.3 billion, +/- $100 million. At the midpoint of this revenue outlook, we expect reported operating margin of approximately 42.6%, +/-150 bps, and adjusted operating margin of approximately 52.0%, +/-100 bps. We are planning for reported EPS to be $3.14, +/-$0.15, and adjusted EPS to be $3.86, +/-$0.15.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed August 19, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
